classifiedFinding.label: L-01
classifiedFinding.title: Index-4 mints revert OnlyDispatcher for 12 broadcast txs (tx 8..19) between hook.setDispatcher and replaceDispatcher, and the cutover has no resume gates, so a halt or gas stall inside the window leaves index 4 unmintable until a manual resume

reconciliation.byHash: new (no ledger entry for this unipooler-cutover fingerprint)
reconciliation.note: manifestation of pps40 L-03 (85095591a60a) in entry point unipooler-cutover; same root cause, still live in this script. Not a fresh duplicate: finding-manager should append 'unipooler-cutover' context / bump lastSeenRun on the target per its own rules, and carry its report forward.

classifiedFinding.description: _runCutover orders step 8 (hook.setDispatcher(UniPoolerV2) = tx 7, then UniPoolerV2.setHook = tx 8), step 9 (setMinter, setPSM, setMaxTout, setBatchMinter, setBatchDonationSize, 4x setAuthorizedPooler, setNudgeStreamer = txs 9..18) and step 10 (replaceDispatcher = tx 19). BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.onDispatch reverts OnlyDispatcher unless msg.sender == dispatcher (BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol:109-110). Once tx 7 lands, the old pooler, which is still configs(4).dispatcher, can no longer dispatch, so every index-4 mint reverts until tx 19 lands. Step 9 depends on neither the hook nor the index, so its 11 txs sit inside the window for no reason. With --slow, a Ledger confirmation per tx and the 0.3 gwei legacy default, the window lasts minutes. If the session halts inside it (Ledger disconnect, gas spike above 0.3 gwei, forge receipt timeout), run() offers no resume: re-running reverts POISONED, or reverts at step 0 'index not on old pooler'/'hook not on old pooler'.
classifiedFinding.impact: Availability only: index-4 NFT mints (the USDS mint) are DoS'd for the session window, and indefinitely after a mid-window halt until the operator hand-sends the remaining txs. No funds at risk.
classifiedFinding.evidence: Fork: test_r41_window_mintsRevertOnlyDispatcher (logs/run41-forktests.log): a mint after step 7 succeeds, after steps 8 and 9 it reverts OnlyDispatcher(). Tx order from the broadcast-mode state diff: side-effects.json transactions.list (logs/fullrun-statediff.log). Same root cause as run-40 pps40 L-03, unchanged by story 103.
classifiedFinding.recommendation: Run step 9 (configure UniPoolerV2) before step 8 in _runCutover. The window then shrinks to setHook + replaceDispatcher (2 txs). Optionally move replaceDispatcher immediately after hook.setDispatcher/setHook. In the runbook, document a receipts-driven manual resume for txs 8..19 (exact cast commands). Safe-config (folds MR-41-UPC-01): before :broadcast, either fund OWNER with at least (sum over all 24 txs of the 2x-estimate gas limit, plus 21k intrinsic each) x CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI — a conservative upper bound on session spend, since each tx's gas limit already carries the 200% multiplier (at the 0.3 gwei default about 0.006 ETH; above ~1.3 gwei the current 0.01303 ETH balance is insufficient), or add a preflight require(OWNER.balance >= totalGasLimit * gasPrice) evaluated before tx 1, and print the computed figure in :preview. Do not raise CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI without re-running that check.

classification.assetImpact: None. Availability of the index-4 (USDS) NFT mint: OnlyDispatcher reverts for txs 8-19 of every session, and indefinitely after a halt inside that window until OWNER hand-sends the remaining txs from run-latest.json receipts.
attackPath: 1. OWNER starts unipooler-cutover:broadcast (--slow, Ledger-confirmed, legacy gas).
2. tx 7 (hook.setDispatcher(UniPoolerV2)) lands; old pooler can no longer dispatch, index 4 still points at it until tx 19 (replaceDispatcher).

3. The session halts inside txs 8-19 for one of: Ledger disconnect, receipt timeout, basefee rising above CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI, or (folded MR-41-UPC-01) OWNER's ETH running out because the override gas price sits in the ~1.45-1.6 gwei band, where cumulative cost plus intrinsic gas and per-tx 2x-limit admission exceeds the 0.01303 ETH balance although the headline cost estimate fits.
4. run() offers no resume (POISONED or step-0 precondition revert); index-4 mints revert until a manual receipts-driven resume.
classification.likelihood: low - needs an operational accident during a minutes-long attended window; the gas-balance variant needs an owner override to ~5x the 0.3 gwei default. No external attacker can trigger it.
classification.assumptions: OWNER is attended and able to hand-send the remaining txs; gas-band numbers are estimates from recorded simulation gas (per-tx eth_estimateGas not captured), not fork-measured.
classification.externalRequirements: A session halt between tx 7 and tx 19.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low, not Medium. The impact is a temporary availability loss of one mint index with no value at risk, triggered only by an operational accident in an attended one-shot session, and fully recoverable by the operator without new code. C4 Medium for availability normally needs a reachable degradation that the protocol cannot promptly cure; here the cure is the owner sending the already-known remaining txs. The folded MR-41-UPC-01 is a genuine Law-3 footgun (a competent owner who checks cost < balance would be surprised that intrinsic gas plus per-tx 2x admission halts the run inside the window), so it is reported, but it adds a halt cause rather than a new impact class and is bounded by the same manual resume. Matches pps40 L-03 (low, open) of which this is a manifestation. Flagged borderline: re-weigh to Medium if the cutover is ever run unattended or if a halt could persist past a point where index-4 users have no alternative.

classifiedFinding.label: L-02
classifiedFinding.title: Script does not mitigate ycn L-28: with the default 10 bps floors and a public-mempool --slow broadcast, a ~30 sUSDS Balancer swap (fee ~$0.10) between tx 4 (withdrawBPT) and tx 5 (exitAndSeed) reverts the exit; 50 bps raises it only to ~160 sUSDS (~$0.53)

classifiedFinding.description: The owner triaged L-28 fix-pending on 2026-10-10 ('will handle it for the cutover'). Story 103's tooling does not handle it. The floors come from quote-balancer-exit-min-amounts.js (default 10 bps, max 50), and the npm :broadcast key sends every tx, including escrow.exitAndSeed, through the public mempool via $RPC_MAINNET. Nothing selects a private relay, and the runbook never mentions one. Anyone watching OWNER's tx 4 can swap on the Balancer phUSD/sUSDS pool so the proportional phUSD out falls below its floor, and tx 5 then reverts in the Vault.
classifiedFinding.impact: DoS of the cutover, repeatable on every retry at about $0.10–$0.53 per attempt. Custody is fail-safe: the BPT stays in the escrow, OWNER is never credited, and abort() or a re-quoted exitAndSeed recover it. Not a loss, but after 30 Oct the pool is paused, which removes the swap vector and forces RECOVERY mode.
classifiedFinding.evidence: Fork: test_r41_L28_griefCost_10bps (20 sUSDS no revert; 30/40/60 sUSDS revert AmountOutBelowMin(phUSD) 0x2f785e46) and test_r41_L28_griefCost_50bps (120 no revert; 160/220 revert). Both also assert that after the grief the escrow still holds 20401.809 BPT, OWNER holds 0, and a re-quoted exitAndSeed succeeds. Pool fee 0.30% (Vault getStaticSwapFeePercentage = 3e15). logs/run41-forktests.log.
classifiedFinding.recommendation: Send the broadcast session (at minimum tx 5) through a private relay (e.g. Flashbots Protect as --rpc-url for :broadcast) and quote at 40–50 bps. Document in //UniPoolerCutover the resume after a griefed tx 5: re-quote on the escrow's BPT and call exitAndSeed privately. Leave L-28 fix-pending until the cutover lands, then apply its closeCondition. Owed-fix note: the owner's L-28 commitment is not reflected in story 103; either amend the runbook/:broadcast key to use a private relay before the session, or record explicitly that the owner accepts public-mempool exposure for this cutover.

classification.assetImpact: None. The BPT stays in the escrow, OWNER is never credited, abort() or a re-quoted exitAndSeed recover (fork-proven). Impact is delay of the one-shot cutover.
attackPath: 1. Griefer watches the public mempool for OWNER's tx 4 (withdrawBPT to escrow).
2. Before tx 5 lands, griefer swaps ~30 sUSDS (10 bps floors) or ~160 sUSDS (50 bps) on the Balancer phUSD/sUSDS pool, cost about $0.10-$0.53 in fees.
3. tx 5 escrow.exitAndSeed reverts AmountOutBelowMin(phUSD).
4. OWNER re-quotes and retries; griefer repeats each attempt until the 30 Oct pool pause removes the swap vector.
classification.likelihood: medium for a single grief (cheap, permissionless, public mempool, --slow); low for sustained denial, since each attempt costs the griefer and the owner can switch to a private relay at any time.
classification.assumptions: Broadcast via public RPC as configured in package.json:76; no private relay.
classification.externalRequirements: A mempool-watching griefer willing to pay per attempt.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low. Griefing DoS of an attended owner operation with fail-safe custody, a fork-proven recovery (re-quote succeeds), and a one-config-line mitigation (private RPC). No asset or protocol-function loss beyond delay, and the window self-closes on 30 Oct (pool pause forces RECOVERY mode, which the tooling supports and fork-proves). Severity matches ycn L-28 (low, fix-pending), of which this is a manifestation. It is surfaced prominently because the owner committed to fixing it for this cutover and the cutover tooling does not.
classifiedFinding.reconcilesWithProject: yield-claim-nft (L-28, fix-pending, closeCondition: successful mainnet cutover)
classifiedFinding.incompleteFixAssessment: No INCOMPLETE FIX signal. ycn L-28 (d77a482de757) is fix-pending on the owner's 2026-10-10 note 'will handle it for the cutover'. Story 103 (auto-complete, phStaging2-Balancexit) contains no reference to L-28, the mempool, a private relay or MEV; its Decisions 8 and Configuration section set floors (default 10 bps, cap 50) for pool drift, not for grief. Story 103 therefore never claims to address L-28, so this is a fix that is owed and not yet delivered, not a fix that landed and is incomplete. Heading: FIX-PENDING STILL LIVE (owed, not delivered). L-28 stays fix-pending; do not auto-close; its closeCondition applies only after a successful mainnet cutover.

classifiedFinding.evidence: Fork: test_r41_pairSyncedDonation_bricksPreview (third-party createPair + 1 wei each + sync makes preview revert 'UniPoolerCutoverCore: pair reserves not empty'); test_r41_pairUnsyncedDonation_doesNotBlock (the unsynced variant is now tolerated). cast call getPair = 0x0.

classification.assetImpact: None. Cutover tooling cannot run until new atomic recovery tooling exists; old pooler keeps serving index 4 and BPT stays recoverable.
attackPath: 1. Before OWNER's tx 1, anyone calls UniswapV2Factory.createPair(sUSDS, phUSD) (getPair is 0x0 today).
2. Griefer transfers 1 wei of each token and calls sync() (~$1-2 gas).
3. Step 2 require(reserves==(0,0)) reverts in preview and broadcast; the script has no recovery branch.
classification.likelihood: low-medium - permissionless and cheap, but needs a griefer targeting this specific pair before an unannounced session; no profit motive.
classification.assumptions: Recovery tooling must be atomic (transfer + pair.mint(UniPoolerV2) in one tx) per run-39.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low. DoS of a one-shot owner tool with no stranded value and no loss of the index-4 mint or the Balancer exit, including past the 30 Oct deadline. The owner already accepted the escrow-side panic (L-26 wont-fix); this manifestation stays open only as the script's missing recovery branch (pps39 L-01, low). Borderline flag retained: re-weigh to Medium only if the old pooler's index-4 dispatch or the RECOVERY exit is shown to fail while the cutover is blocked.
classifiedFinding.disclosure: Same root cause as yield-claim-nft L-26 (b2a29359fde5), owner-set wont-fix 2026-10-07, triageReason: 'I guess, it should just panic and then I'll have to figure out what to do if there is a pair. I think it's safe to mark as won't fix.' Not re-raised: this entry tracks the phStaging script's missing recovery branch, reconciled to open pps39 L-01 (9a694ae01fe1).
classifiedFinding.deadlineAssessment: A pre-cutover brick past 30 Oct strands nothing. The brick fires at step 2, before withdrawBPT (tx 4), so the BPT never leaves the old BalancerPoolerV2. Index-4 dispatch on the old pooler wraps USDS to sUSDS without calling the Balancer Vault (BalancerPoolerV2 dispatch never calls addLiquidity, pinned by its tests), so mints keep working after the pool pause; only pool() stops, and accumulated sUSDS stays rescuable via rescueERC20. After the pause, the BPT is still exitable via RECOVERY once the permissionless enableRecoveryMode is called (fork-proven, test_r41_recovery_*). The run-39 Medium trigger (index-4 or Balancer exit dies while cutover is blocked) is therefore not met.

classifiedFinding.description: With --skip-simulation, every 'read live' amount in step 11 (sUSDSRescued = balanceOf(oldPooler)) and the 'old pooler not drained' require are evaluated only in forge's local pass, and the amount is fixed in tx 20's calldata. Any public index-4 mint landing between the local pass and tx 7 wraps USDS into sUSDS on the old pooler (16.3 sUSDS per mint at the current price). So can any 1-wei donation of sUSDS/USDS/BPT to the old pooler. That residue survives tx 20, tx 24 pauses the pool, and _checkDrained keeps 'old pooler empty' a HARD require (revision 2 kept it hard on purpose). The :broadcast tail '&& npm run unipooler-cutover:verify' then exits non-zero right after a successful cutover.
classifiedFinding.impact: Operational only. The verify chain breaks and needs one OWNER rescueERC20(token, UniPoolerV2, residue) tx, which is not pause-gated and is contract-to-contract. A stranger can re-grief :verify at any time after the cutover with 1 wei, the same donation class that revision 2 downgraded to a warning for the escrow.
classifiedFinding.evidence: Fork: test_r41_bakedRescue_interimDust_failsVerify_ownerCanSweep: full cutover, +16 sUSDS on the old pooler, verify reverts 'verify: old pooler holds sUSDS'; OWNER rescueERC20 then verify passes. BalancerPoolerV2.sol:437-440 (rescueERC20 not pause-gated).
classifiedFinding.recommendation: In _checkDrained, keep 'old pooler holds 0 BPT' hard but report sUSDS/USDS residue as a WARNING with the exact rescueERC20 command, or compare against a small dust threshold. In the runbook, note that interim mints during txs 1..7 leave sUSDS to sweep.

classification.assetImpact: None. :verify fails after a successful cutover; one OWNER rescueERC20 (not pause-gated) clears it.
attackPath: 1. An index-4 mint or 1-wei donation lands on the old pooler between forge's local pass and tx 7/20.
2. Baked rescue amount leaves a residue; old pooler paused at tx 24.
3. :verify hard-requires old pooler empty and exits non-zero.
classification.likelihood: medium (public mints happen), impact operational only.

classifiedFinding.justification: QA. Incorrect post-condition / state handling in verification tooling with a trivial owner remedy and no asset or availability impact; matches pps40 Q-01 (qa, open).

classifiedFinding.label: Q-02
classifiedFinding.title: No resume tooling: story-specified step gating was replaced by all-or-nothing refusal, _alreadyCompleted treats configs(4)==UniPooler as 'completed' so a crash after tx 19 re-runs as 'Nothing to do', and the header's claim that any re-funding of an existing escrow goes through _fundEscrow is true of no reachable path
classifiedFinding.description: Story 103 Technical Details require 'step gating via _isConfigured/_trackConfig'. The implementation (story Decision 7, disclosed) writes the progress file once, at the end of forge's local pass, as 'completed', and has no step gating. _alreadyCompleted returns 'Nothing to do - no transaction sent' when the file is completed, the UniPooler has code and configs(4)==UniPooler. That is tx 19's effect alone, and txs 20-24 (sUSDS rescue, USDS rescue, wrapUsds, old.setMinter(OWNER), old.pause()) may not have landed. Separately, the header states 'Any re-funding of an existing escrow goes through the core's guarded _fundEscrow' (:53-54), but no entry point ever calls _fundEscrow on an existing escrow: run() always deploys a fresh pooler and escrow. A resume into an existing escrow is a hand-typed cast withdrawBPT with no L-27 guard.
classifiedFinding.impact: Misleading operator output on the most likely partial-failure path; :verify, next in the && chain, does catch it ('verify: old pooler not paused'). The L-27 protection on the manual-resume path rests only on the header rule, which the owner is trusted to follow. Live state also lowers the L-27 stakes: the old pooler holds only escrow snapshot tokens.
classifiedFinding.evidence: Fork: test_r41_crashAfterReplaceDispatcher_rerunIsNoOp_verifyCatches (re-run no-op, verify reverts 'verify: old pooler not paused'); test_r41_L27_withoutGuard_manualResumeStrandsX (the unguarded manual path strands a non-snapshot token). Story file 'Technical Details / Progress' bullet; Decision 7.
classifiedFinding.recommendation: Make _alreadyCompleted require the full end state (old pooler paused, minter OWNER, drained) and otherwise print a precise list of which of txs 20..24 are missing. Correct the header sentence, or add a small RESUME_ESCROW=<addr> entry point that calls _fundEscrow / exitAndSeed / step 11-12 against an existing escrow behind the same guards.

classification.assetImpact: None. Misleading 'Nothing to do' output after a crash between tx 19 and tx 24; :verify (next in the && chain) catches it. Header claim about _fundEscrow is inaccurate, leaving the manual resume path guarded only by the owner following the header rule.
attackPath: 1. Session crashes after tx 19 lands.
2. Re-run sees configs(4)==UniPooler and prints 'Nothing to do'.
3. :verify reverts 'old pooler not paused'; operator must hand-send txs 20-24.
classification.assumptions: Owner is trusted to follow the header's resume rule (Law 3).

classifiedFinding.justification: QA. Misleading operator output and an inaccurate comment on a partial-failure path that the existing :verify step already detects; no funds or availability at risk. The L-27 manual-resume strand requires a non-snapshot token the old pooler does not hold today.
relatedLedger: story-103 review carry-forward [low] 'no guarded script entry point for resuming into an existing escrow'
classifiedFinding.specConformanceNote: Also cross-listed in spec-conformance.md: story 103 Technical Details require step gating via _isConfigured/_trackConfig; the implementation replaces it with all-or-nothing refusal (disclosed as the story's own Decision 7). Deviation is disclosed, so honest severity is QA; listed under spec-conformance by reference to Q-02 rather than as a separate F label.

classifiedFinding.label: Q-03
classifiedFinding.title: Plan §4 step 11's post-broadcast 'forked test mint dispatches, wraps and accrues debt' never runs against landed state: :verify has no simulated mint and the :broadcast tail's trailing :preview is a guaranteed no-op
classifiedFinding.description: Story 103 Background quotes Plan §4 step 11 'Verify: … A forked test mint dispatches, wraps and accrues debt.' The implementation performs the mint only in _previewEndToEnd, pre-broadcast, on simulated state. VerifyUniPoolerCutover checks wiring and simulates pool() but not a mint. The :broadcast tail '… && npm run unipooler-cutover:verify && npm run unipooler-cutover:preview' re-runs preview, which returns at _alreadyCompleted() before any E2E code once the progress file is completed and live. The trailing step therefore cannot exercise the landed contracts.

classifiedFinding.evidence: Fork: test_r41_fullRun_stateDiff_verify shows the ':preview tail is a no-op' assertion and the log line 'Nothing to do - no transaction sent'. VerifyUniPoolerCutover.s.sol:35-85 has no mint.
classifiedFinding.recommendation: Move the dealt-user test mint (in a reverted snapshot) into VerifyUniPoolerCutover.run, next to _simulateQuotedPool, and drop or relabel the trailing :preview in :broadcast.

classification.assetImpact: None. Verification gap; _checkWiring covers most mint-path dependencies.
attackPath: 1. :broadcast tail runs :verify (no mint) then :preview, which returns at _alreadyCompleted before E2E code.
2. No end-to-end mint is ever exercised against landed contracts.

classifiedFinding.justification: QA. A missing verification step with partial coverage elsewhere; no direct impact. Tagged faithfulness for the Plan/story deviation.
